summary: From the page loading to the focused V shown complete and interactive, with the V asked for as soon as the store answers.

steps.does: The window learns which library it works in and whether to warm.
Starts the window's run and its children; the actor ID comes from the random source.
Starts decoding the last V's files at once, before anything else is known.
Loads the window's profile, its focused V, look, presets, layout and views from snapshots and short tails.
Makes the panel instances; the main view's panel is visible, which is the demand for its view.
Paints the first frame of the shell.
Creates the view's runtime and demands its scene.
Demands the body's core and loads the head; in parallel the V is asked for.
Answers from the prepared core, or derives it (cold only) with progress in place.
Builds the head in the scene runtime.
Derives the V's character request purely from her node and the scene's flags.
Asks the host for the request, superseding only this window's older one.
Answers from a kept answer after a stamp check, or prepares the record.
Loads the record's parts, claiming the warm files and reusing the pool, then swaps them in one step.
Rasters every layer of the look's eye makeup preset at the current tier.
Draws the view once something changed, and stops demanding frames when nothing animates.

demand: The main view panel's visibility: view → scene → V → preparation and core; the look's rasters from the same view.

faults.when: No game folder or WolvenKit is known.
The masculine core can't be prepared.

latency: Page shown to interactive under 1 s (met today: first paint 0.28–0.30 s).
Warm restart to the own V complete under 2 s (not met today: 2.8–3.0 s, because the V is asked for only after the head, idle and blink load).
Cold preparation 20–29 s, with progress shown in place from the first moment.
budget.memory: The default V is about 100 MB over 80 files, held by reference; the warm files are released once claimed or after their keep time.

invariants: Every running process traces its demand to the window's run through a chain of requests.
The V is asked for in the same cycle the store delivers her node, never after the head loads.
No main-thread task runs over 50 ms.
A view never shows a V's parts from two different records at once (the swap is one step).
Nothing is drawn for a view that isn't visible.

x-friction.gap: V preparation is host work the page follows by polling today.
x-friction.closes: Work in another process observed as a process here.
